integration: registered as granular REQUIRED_RED scenarios in contracts/packs/required-red-v1.json; not a direct corpus fixture until its complete fixture contract is registered
known_gaps: The current corpus fixture schema has no mutation/interleaving primitive. Post-lock source replacement cannot be expressed or executed without a controlled actor; it remains a required fault-injection case rather than a falsely passing fixture.

The schema permits only inline base64 initial bytes. Exact 16 MiB and 16 MiB+1 source fixtures would add more than 44 MiB of duplicated JSON to this contribution. They are specified obligations but intentionally not materialized here until the runner supports deterministic fixture blobs.

Malformed locations, coordinate failures, and anchor mismatch remain REQUIRED_RED until direct fixtures are added. Their public symbols are now normative in docs/v1/source-and-location.md and docs/v1/schema/v1.json; this pack does not invent alternate outputs.
The checked-in executable fixture subset below is deliberately independent of the central corpus and inventory, as required; it is not automatically run by the current runner.
